dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Look at this pottery, Nam! Is it all handmade?
dialogue.reading: ˈlʊk ət ðɪs ˈpɑːtəri, ˈnɑːm! ɪz ɪt ˈɔːl ˌhændˈmeɪd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. Everything in this room was made by hand by a well-known artist from the north.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɪn ðɪs ˈruːm wʌz ˈmeɪd baɪ ˈhænd baɪ ə ˌwɛlˈnoʊn ˈɑːrtɪst frəm ðə ˈnɔːrθ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: This bowl is so eye-catching. Look at that bright blue!
dialogue.reading: ðɪs ˈboʊl ɪz soʊ ˈaɪ ˌkætʃɪŋ. ˈlʊk ət ðæt ˈbraɪt ˈbluː!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's beautiful. The artist is world-famous now. Her bowls are in museums in Japan and Korea.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈbjuːtəfəl. ði ˈɑːrtɪst ɪz ˌwɜːrld ˈfeɪməs ˈnaʊ. hɜːr ˈboʊlz ər ɪn mjuˈziːəmz ɪn dʒəˈpæn ənd kəˈriːə.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Well, it's a world-famous, handmade bowl!
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛl, ɪts ə ˌwɜːrld ˈfeɪməs, ˌhændˈmeɪd ˈboʊl!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Our grandmother has bowls like this in her kitchen. She says they're old-fashioned.
dialogue.reading: aʊr ˈɡrænmʌðər ˈhæz ˈboʊlz ˈlaɪk ðɪs ɪn hɜːr ˈkɪtʃən. ʃiː ˈsɛz ðɛr ˌoʊld ˈfæʃənd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Old-fashioned things are popular again. Maybe her bowls are worth a lot of money!
dialogue.reading: ˌoʊld ˈfæʃənd ˈθɪŋz ər ˈpɑːpjələr əˈɡɛn. ˈmeɪbi hɜːr ˈboʊlz ər ˈwɜːrθ ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈmʌni!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Then I'm going to visit her this weekend!
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈvɪzɪt hɜːr ðɪs ˈwiːkɛnd!
